title: Adriana Imai
current_flag: This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 10.2.0

history.desc: Patch 6.6.2 Rework : made a series of changes in order to reduce The Skull Merchant's ability to hold Generator setups while making her more threatening in a Chase. Buff : The Skull Merchant now receives the Haste Status Effect at increasing strength for each Survivor trackable by her Radar. Buff : vaulting a Pallet with a Claw Trap attached now causes it to break, destroying the Claw Trap in the process. This new base-kit ability is a modified version of the original effect of the Ultrasonic Speaker Add-on. Buff : Drones now enter an Unhackable State whenever a Survivor with a Claw Trap is near. Quality of Life : Claw Traps are now automatically destroyed once their Battery Life expires. Quality of Life : Claw Traps no longer have their Battery refilled when a Survivor enters a Drone's Area of Effect. Nerf : Drones now only return to The Skull Merchant once their respective Claw Traps are destroyed, rather than automatically 10 seconds after hacking it.

Patch 7.3.0 Rework : extensive rework to The Skull Merchant's Power. Change : overhauled the Drone mechanics to prevent them from being primarily used to defend Generators. Drones no longer have an Active Zone, they now use their Laser Beams to detect moving Survivors and inflict them with Lock On. Active Drones now have two modes: Stealth and Scouting, with the former hiding the Laser Beam. Survivors detected by a Drone will now gain +1 Stack of Lock On when crossing a Laser Beam, up to 3 Stacks, after which the Survivor receives a Claw Trap. Failing to hack a Drone applies +1 Stack of Lock On. Healthy Survivors who receive a Claw Trap will enter the Injured State. Injured Survivors who receive a Claw Trap will suffer from the Deep Wound Status Effect instead. Claw Traps apply the Broken Status Effect while they are attached. Survivors that are detected by a Drone will suffer from a 10 % Hindered Status Effect for 6 seconds, and will be revealed by Killer Instinct for 3 seconds. Buff : using the Scanner no longer reduces Movement speed. Buff : increased the maximum number of Drones from 4 to 6. Buff : grants the Undetectable Status Effect for 8 seconds when placing a Drone. Buff : reduced the minimum distance between Drones from 22 metres to 16 metres. Buff : Drones can now be placed above and below other Drones when on different floors. Buff : reduced the activation time of Drones from 1.5 seconds to 0.3 seconds. Nerf : Drones no longer detect Survivors through walls or floors of multi-level maps. Nerf : Drones can no longer be manually reactivated. Nerf : vaulting a Pallet with a Claw Trap attached no longer causes the Pallet to break. Nerf : hacking a Drone will now disable it for 45 seconds instead of applying a Claw Trap. Buff : reduced footstep audio to make The Skull Merchant harder to track. Buff : added the ability for The Skull Merchant to change the rotation of a Drone's Laser Beam using the Radar. Change : when a Drone is deployed, its Laser Beams will spawn perpendicular to The Skull Merchant view, allowing her to possible get an immediate scan on a Survivor in front of her. Quality of Life : removed the Cool-down for recalling a Drone and made the option available at any time, regardless of whether Eyes in the Sky is on cool-down otherwise or not. Change : updated The Skull Merchant's Chase Music. Change : received an Add-on pass, tweaking and reworking several Add-ons.
Patch 7.3.1 Quality of Life : added unique prompts to differentiate which direction a Drone will rotate in.
Patch 7.5.0 Quality of Life : the Laser Cones emitted by Drones now lighter in appearance and colour when it cannot detect you as a Survivor.

Patch 8.3.0 Buff : The Skull Merchant now gains a +5 % Haste Status Effect if a Survivor is scanned by a Drone within 5 seconds of placing it or changing its rotation. Buff : increased the Rotation speed from 85°/s to 95°/s. Buff : reduced the duration a Survivor is immune to being scanned in succession from 3 seconds to 2.5 seconds. Nerf : reduced the strength of the Hindered Status Effect when scanning a Claw-Trapped Survivor from -10 % to -8 %. Nerf : now suffers from a penalty to her Movement speed when deploying a Drone or while inspecting the Radar, reducing it to 4.4 m/s. Nerf : reduced the number of Scan Lines from 2 to 1. Nerf : removed the Stealth Mode, Drones are now always in Scouting Mode and active. Nerf : Survivors who are fast-vaulting can no longer be detected by Drones. Nerf : The Skull Merchant no longer gains Haste from Survivors having a Claw Trap. Change : Scan Lines are now only visible within 16 metres. This change is mixed, since it affects both Survivors and The Skull Merchant, acting as a buff and a nerf towards her ability simultaneously.

Patch 8.3.2 Partial Reversal : removed the Movement Speed penalty for inspecting the Radar. Partial Reversal : Scan Lines are again visible to The Skull Merchant at all times, regardless of her distance. Buff : while inspecting the Radar, the Auras of Scan Lines are now revealed to The Skull Merchant within 32 metres of the Drone(s).
Patch 8.6.0 Buff : reduced the Terror Radius from 32 metres to 24 metres.

Patch 9.3.0 Buff : Increased the Rotation speed from 95 °/s to 105 °/s. Buff : Increased the strength of the Hindered Status Effect applied to scanned Survivors from 8 % to 10 %. Buff : Reduced the Cool-down time to deploying Drones from 10 seconds to 7 seconds. Buff : Rushed Vault actions no longer grant Survivors immunity from being detected by Scan Lines. Quality of Life : Drones now only rise when colliding directly with The Skull Merchant. Nerf : Reduced the duration of the Undetectable Status Effect granted after deploying Drones from 8 seconds to 6 seconds. Nerf : Survivors underneath a Drone are no longer instantly Locked On, but rather accumulate Lock On every 2.5 seconds now.

Patch 9.3.2 Reversal : Increased the duration of the Undetectable Status Effect granted after deploying Drones from 6 seconds to 8 seconds. Change : Decoupled the Undetectable Status Effect status effect from Deploying Drones to instead Gain Undetectable Status Effect when Recalling Drones instead.
Patch 9.6.0 Quality of Life : Added support to multiple Power icons. Quality of Life : New Power Icons mapped to Deploy Drone, Rotate and Recall actions.

title: Bubba Sawyer
current_flag: This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 10.2.0

history.desc: Patch 1.7.2 Nerf : Bloodlust is now reset when revving The Chainsaw.
Patch 3.1.0 Quality of Life : adjusted the cool-down for successful Chainsaw attacks to be the same as for missed attacks (adjusted Movement speed and reduced duration from 3 seconds to 2 seconds ).

Patch 4.1.0 Rework : reworked Bubba's Chainsaw and the majority of its Add-ons. Buff : added Charges to Bubba's Chainsaw, allowing him to extend the duration of his Chainsaw Sweep by consuming Charges as well as increase its speed. Buff : increased movement speed during Chainsaw Sweep from 5.06 m/s to 5.29 m/s. Buff : removed the secondary action to initiate a Chainsaw Sweep when the revving bar is fully charged, allowing it to activate as soon as the bar is completely full. Nerf : added a cool-down after missing a Chainsaw Sweep, with the duration dependent on the number of Charges consumed during the respective Chainsaw Sweep. Quality of Life : downing a Survivor with Bubba's Chainsaw no longer inflict the same cool-down as when performing a missed Chainsaw Sweep, regardless of the number of Charges spent. Nerf : Bubba's Chainsaw is now disabled when no charges are available until they are replenished. Nerf : added a Tantrum meter, causing The Cannibal to enter a Tantrum after revving Bubba's Chainsaw for too long without initiating a Chainsaw Sweep. Nerf : added an extended cool-down towards Tantrum that is dependent on the number of Charges consumed when running into an obstacle. Nerf : entering a Tantrum by any means now depletes all Charges and disables Bubba's Chainsaw until the Tantrum ends. Quality of Life : the Tantrum cool-down is now unchanged if The Cannibal runs into an obstacle after downing a Survivor during the same Chainsaw Sweep. Quality of Life : the Tantrum meter now immediately depletes after cancelling revving Bubba's Chainsaw. Change : reworked nearly all Add-ons so that The Cannibal no longer shares them with The Hillbilly, making them exclusive to The Cannibal.

Patch 5.5.0 Change : removed the Survivor Masks of the original four Survivors that could be unlocked by sacrificing them 25 times each. This change was motivated by issues with racism in post-game chats in conjunction with Claudette's mask [ 2 ].

Patch 7.3.0 Nerf : Survivors benefitting from the Endurance Status Effect are now immune from being hit a second time by a Chainsaw Sweep within 0.5 seconds. This prevents The Cannibal from downing a freshly unhooked Survivor immediately below the Hook, before that Survivor had a chance to run away.

Patch 8.0.0 Buff : increased the Chainsaw Sweep duration from 2 seconds to 2.5 seconds per Token. Buff : increased the Movement speed during Chainsaw Sweep from 5.29 m/s to 5.35 m/s. Buff : reduced the size of the Collision detection from 17.5 cm to 10 cm. This change assists The Cannibal in better navigating tight spaces. Buff : reduced the base Tantrum duration from 5 seconds to 3 seconds. This was accomplished by reducing the Power Gauge capacity from 5 Charges to 3 Charges, since a Tantrum discharges it at a fixed rate of -1 c/s. This change results in an Indirect Nerf, as it effectively reduces the time The Cannibal can rev his Chainsaw for, before he reaches the Tantrum limit. Undocumented Buff : reduced the cap on the maximum Tantrum duration from 8 seconds to 6 seconds. Change : adjusted several Add-ons in accordance with the changes mentioned above.
Unknown Patch Undocumented Change : changed the Memento Mori POV to Third Person, making it identical to the Survivors' POV.
Patch 9.6.0 Buff : increased the Movement speed during Chainsaw Sweep from 5.35 m/s to 5.45 m/s.

title: Philip Ojomo

history.desc: Patch 1.2.0 Buff : increased the Shimmer effect when The Wraith is cloaked. Quality of Life : reduced the volume of all sounds The Wraith makes when cloaked. Quality of Life : The Wraith no longer disturbs Crows when passing near them while cloaked.

Patch 1.3.0 Quality of Life : added a Bell model and animation while The Wraith cloaks and uncloaks. Quality of Life : The Wraith now starts the Trial cloaked (will cloak during the initial camera panning).
Patch 1.5.0 Nerf : Bloodlust no longer accumulates while Cloaked.
Patch 1.7.1 Quality of Life : reduced the volume of The Wraith's growling while cloaked.
Patch 1.8.0 Quality of Life : reduced the volume of The Wraith's growling further from the Survivor POV.

Patch 1.8.3 Buff : the Bell Toll sound when uncloaking is delayed by 1.5 seconds (50 % of the animation) to allow for surprising Survivors. Buff : increased the Lightburn Burning time from 1 seconds to 1.5 seconds. Buff : when cloaked, The Wraith now sees Pools of Blood left by Survivors in bright red. Quality of Life : the Wailing Bell ringing audio is capped at 24 metres instead of formerly sounding map-wide. Quality of Life : the *Wooosh* audio following cloaking is capped at 40 metres instead of formerly sounding map-wide. Quality of Life : reduced and adjusted the Cloaking and Uncloaking Speed penalties. Quality of Life : when cloaked, The Wraith can now interact with Props, which cause him to temporarily uncloak during the interaction.

Patch 2.0.0 Buff : reduced the Lightburn Stun time from 4 seconds to 3 seconds. Quality of Life : fixed an issue that had his Red Stain, as well as his Terror Radius linger for a few moments after cloaking.
Patch 2.1.0 Quality of Life : adjusted the timing of the smoke effect and bell audio when uncloaking to avoid giving his position away too early.

Patch 2.2.0 Buff : incorporated the effect of the former "Windstorm" Add-ons into The Wraith's base-kit, granting him a speed burst upon uncloaking. Adjusted the Movement Speed curve when uncloaking. Buff : further increased the Lightburn Burning time from 1.5 seconds to 2 seconds. Quality of Life : removed the Movement Speed penalty when cloaking. Quality of Life : The Wraith can now immediately attack/interact after uncloaking instead of having to wait 0.3 seconds. Change : revisited all Add-ons.
Patch 2.3.0 Quality of Life : reduced the footstep audio.

Patch 2.7.0 Quality of Life : when cancelling the cloaking interaction, The Wraith can now attack/interact immediately rather than having to wait for the bell-stowing animation to finish. Quality of Life : restored a missing rattling sound effect when starting to cloak.
Patch 3.3.1 Buff : updated The Wraith's Power with the Undetectable Status Effect.

Patch 4.5.0 Buff : made The Wraith completely invisible to Survivors that are farther than o 20 metres away when cloaked. Buff : increased the post-uncloak Speed Boost duration from 1 second to 1.25 seconds. Quality of Life : again restored the missing rattling sound effect when starting to cloak ( "Bell Tech" ). Quality of Life : The Wraith now only uncloaks the necessary bits when interacting with Props when cloaked, instead of almost completely uncloaking.
Patch 4.6.0 Buff : increased The Wraith' s Movement speed when cloaked from 5.06 m/s to 6.0 m/s. Nerf : reduced The Wraith' s Movement speed when uncloaking from 2.024 m/s to 1.6 m/s.

Patch 5.1.0 Change : The Wraith is now locked to all new Players to Dead by Daylight, or returning Players who did not progress him until this Patch, and must now be unlocked by completing the Killer Tutorial first.
Patch 5.3.0 Nerf : reduced the duration of the Speed Boost after uncloaking from 1.25 seconds to 1 second.
Patch 6.7.0 Buff : removed the Lightburn mechanic.

history.desc: Patch 6.6.0 Quality of Life : removed the HUD elements when using the Inexorable Stare to allow for a more cinematic experience when killing Survivors this way.

history.desc: Patch 1.1.2 Nerf : added Lightburn vulnerability. Nerf : reduced the default charges of Spencer's Last Breath from 3 Blinks to 2 Blinks. This, in conjunction to a Nerf to Fragile Wheeze, reduced the maximum number of available Blinks and Chain Blinks from 7 Blinks to 5 Blinks. 7 Blinks were possible with the 1.1.0-1.1.1 versions of Fragile Wheeze and Campbell's Last Breath. Patch 1.9.0 Quality of Life : standardised The Nurse's post-Blink Lunge to the default variation shared by all Killers now. This now allows for full rotation mid-Lunge compared to the former Lunge which was restricted to a straight path and could not avoid potential obstacles by curving around them. Quality of Life : a Blink's duration is now determined by how long a Blink was charged for. Charging duration still determines the maximum available Blink distance, but The Nurse is no longer committed to that distance and can shorten her travel path by aiming her camera to a desired spot closer to her. Quality of Life : The Nurse can now blink upwards and downwards, including through floors and ceilings.

Patch 5.5.0 Quality of Life : rewrote the majority of the code governing The Nurse, especially net-working, to fix a plethora of issues that plagued her over the years.

Patch 6.5.0 Quality of Life : added a new sound cue that plays when The Nurse has fully regenerated all her Blink charges. Nerf : any attack following a Blink and before The Nurse succumbs to Fatigue is now considered a Special Attack and no longer activates any effects associated with Basic Attacks. Change : received a second Add-on Pass, which brings her strongest and her weakest Add-ons in line with the rest. Change : The Nurse now features a unique Menu Music, Terror Radius and Chase Music.
Patch 6.7.0 Buff : removed the Lightburn mechanic.
Patch 8.3.2 Undocumented Change : slightly altered the Memento Mori animation.
